sources.title: Managing Inrush Current
facts: For a constant capacitance reference, capacitor current is capacitance times instantaneous voltage slew. Average voltage rise over an interval does not guarantee a maximum instantaneous slew.

sources.title: TPS2553 datasheet
facts: Output rise-time table uses CL1uF,RL100ohm; at VIN6.5V typ1.1ms/max1.5ms; at VIN2.5V typ0.7ms/max1ms. MIN column is blank in both rows.
These times do not supply a guaranteed maximum instantaneous slew for the current28.2uF nominal switched rail.
TPS2553 is the constant-current variant; TPS2553-1 is a different latch-off variant.
